link.note: Probable to confirmed: baptized Lavenham 11 Sep 1586 to William & Agnes (Neves) Payne (Moriarty, NEHGR 79:82–84; NEHGR 69:251–2; Anderson, Great Migration). Supersedes Hammond 1902's Nowton parish theory.

summary: John's 11th-great-grandmother; crossed to New England on the Francis in 1634 aged 47.
bio: Baptized Lavenham 11 Sep 1586. Siblings: the emigrants William Paine of Ipswich and Boston, Dorothy (Paine) Eire and Phebe (Paine) Page. Sailed from Ipswich on the Francis, April 1634, aged 47, with Elizabeth (15), Sarah (10) and John (7). Died 1670 aged 83. Hammond (1902, p. 59) had considered and rejected the Lavenham Elizabeth, placing her in Nowton parish; later scholarship reverses that.
sources: Anderson, Great Migration Begins pp. 852–3; Great Migration vol. V
